post.description:
Multipart file and form fields; dry_run validates the bundle and returns a preview without
storing anything.

Requires the `manage_skills` permission.

get.description:
Every live Group, for the upload form's Group picker.

Requires the `manage_skills` permission.

patch.description:
Edits the display fields in place, changes who the skill reaches, and is_active publishes a
draft, republishes or unpublishes.

Requires the `manage_skills` permission.

Enables a Merge-managed skill for this organization, or disables it.

Requires the `manage_skills` permission.

put.description:
Pins a live skill to one person on top of who it already reaches.

Requires the `manage_skills` permission.

ToolClass.description: Read from a tool's MCP annotations with the spec's defaults; see plans/access-control.md.
ToolClass.title: ToolClass

AccessRequestFilter.description:
A list filter: a status, except APPROVED is approvals still in force and EXPIRED is
approvals whose end date has passed.
AccessRequestFilter.title: AccessRequestFilter

SourceSubject.description: What grants a tool in effective access: a policy's subject, or an approved request.
SourceSubject.title: SourceSubject

SkillListView.description: The console's tabs: live skills, not-live drafts, the review queue, and Merge's globals by source.
SkillListView.title: SkillListView

SkillSource.description: Organization skills are AUTHORED; Merge's global skills are EXAMPLE or AUTO_GENERATED.
SkillSource.title: SkillSource

SkillVisibility.description: PERSONAL skills reach only their author; ORG covers both organization-wide and Group reach.
SkillVisibility.title: SkillVisibility

SkillAccessScope.description: Who an organization skill reaches: everyone, some Groups, or only its author.
SkillAccessScope.title: SkillAccessScope

SkillProvisioningScope.description: Who an organization reaches with an enabled global skill: everyone, some Groups, or named people.
SkillProvisioningScope.title: SkillProvisioningScope

SkillReach.description: scope is None for a global this organization hasn't enabled.
SkillReach.title: SkillReach

SkillVersionStatus.description: Agent Handler's version lifecycle; review and deprecation arrive in later slices.
SkillVersionStatus.title: SkillVersionStatus

SkillPreview.description: A validated bundle's metadata; nothing is stored.
SkillPreview.title: SkillPreview

EnablementRequest.description:
Enable a Merge-managed skill for everyone, some Groups or named people, or disable it. Without
a scope, enabling keeps the organization's current one.
EnablementRequest.title: EnablementRequest

OrganizationApiKey.description: An organization API key (`mfw_org_key_...`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create one under Settings → API keys.

ScimToken.description: A SCIM token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
